reports.title: ZoomInfo Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Based on information available as of November 4, 2026, ZoomInfo is providing guidance for the fourth quarter and full year 2026 as follows:

Q4 2026 | Prior FY 2026 | FY 2026
GAAP Revenue | $294 - $297 million | $1.207 - $1.217 billion | $1.2235 - $1.2265 billion
Non-GAAP Adjusted Operating Income | $113 - $116 million | $446 - $451 million | $452 - $455 million
Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Income Per Share (Diluted) | $0.285 - $0.295 | $1.12 - $1.13 | $1.125 - $1.135
Non-GAAP Unlevered Free Cash Flow | Not Guided | $403 - $423 million | $405 - $425 million
Weighted Average Shares Outstanding | 321 million | 318 million | 318 million
